item.title: In Munich, it's never too early for a breakfast beer with sausage and pretzels
item.description: Bavarians traditionally wash down a breakfast of boiled veal sausage, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel with beer — all before the church bells ring at midday.

item.title: Tanker sailors still face danger in the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: An agreement over the Strait of Hormuz is still far away. Tim Wilkins, who works for a tanker industry group, says the ships stuck around the waterway are in limbo, and transiting is still dangerous.

item.title: Ukraine mourns 'collector of souls' Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
item.description: Oleksiy Yukov spent two decades recovering the bodies of soldiers — including many Russians. He was killed during a recovery mission after stepping on a landmine.

item.title: Switzerland is a neutral nation but has more nuclear bunkers than any country in the world
item.description: Instead of scrapping its network of bomb shelters after the Cold War, Switzerland kept building them. The country has more than 370,000 nuclear bomb shelters. Some are now used to house migrants.
